payload.subject: chinese
payload.title: 易错字词
payload.description: 沮丧（jǔ sàng）：灰心失望。狼藉（láng jí）：乱七八糟、杂乱不堪。蹒跚（pán shān）：腿脚不灵便、走路缓慢摇摆的样子。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: chinese
payload.title: 成语辨析
payload.description: “首当其冲”指最先受到攻击或遭遇灾难；“首屈一指”指位居第一、最好。辨析时应结合语境与感情色彩。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: chinese
payload.title: 春望
payload.description: 杜甫，唐代。《春望》：国破山河在，城春草木深。感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心。烽火连三月，家书抵万金。白头搔更短，浑欲不胜簪。表达忧国伤时、思家悲己之情。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: math
payload.title: 一元一次方程
payload.description: 通过等式两边进行相同的合法运算保持等式成立，逐步求出未知数；代入原方程检验。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: math
payload.title: 二次函数
payload.description: 二次函数 y=ax²+bx+c（a≠0）的顶点横坐标为 −b/(2a)。配方为 y=a(x−h)²+k，顶点为(h,k)。a>0 时有最小值k。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: math
payload.title: 三角形与勾股定理
payload.description: 直角三角形两直角边a、b与斜边c满足a²+b²=c²。使用前必须确认直角与斜边的位置。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: english
payload.title: Suspense
payload.description: Suspense is the reader’s feeling of uncertainty and anticipation about what will happen. Delayed information, foreshadowing, pacing and threatened outcomes can create suspense.
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: english
payload.title: Foreshadowing
payload.description: Foreshadowing is a clue that hints at a later event. It prepares readers for developments without fully revealing them. It differs from a flashback, which presents an earlier event.
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: english
payload.title: Symbolism
payload.description: Symbolism uses a concrete object, action or image to suggest an abstract meaning beyond its literal role. A symbol’s meaning depends on its textual context.
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: ce
payload.title: Subject–verb agreement
payload.description: The verb agrees in number with the subject, not with a noun in an intervening prepositional phrase. “The collection of essays is useful.”
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: ce
payload.title: Verb tense
payload.description: Use tense consistently to express the intended sequence of events. Past perfect describes an event completed before another past event.
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: ce
payload.title: Pronouns
payload.description: Pronouns need clear antecedents and agreement in number. Choose subjective, objective or possessive forms according to the pronoun’s grammatical role.
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: physics
payload.title: 运动与速度

payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: physics
payload.title: 声音的产生与传播
payload.description: 声音由物体振动产生，传播需要介质，真空不能传声。音调与频率有关，响度与振幅和距离等因素有关。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: physics
payload.title: 熔化与汽化
payload.description: 熔化是固态变为液态，汽化是液态变为气态，二者都吸热。晶体在熔化过程中持续吸热而温度保持不变。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: chemistry
payload.title: 物质性质与变化
payload.description: 物理变化没有生成其他物质，化学变化生成了其他物质。判断依据是是否生成新物质，而不能仅凭发光、发热或颜色变化。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: chemistry
payload.title: 空气与氧气
payload.description: 空气按体积分数约含78%氮气、21%氧气。氧气能支持燃烧，但氧气本身通常不作燃料。
payload.source: Review 基础学习包 · 原创整理

payload.subject: chemistry
payload.title: 分子、原子与元素
payload.description: 原子是化学变化中的最小粒子。元素是质子数相同的一类原子的总称。分子是保持由分子构成的物质化学性质的最小粒子。

payload.subject: biology
payload.title: 细胞的结构与功能
payload.description: 细胞是生物体结构和功能的基本单位。比较动物细胞和植物细胞，理解细胞膜、细胞质、细胞核、线粒体、叶绿体和液泡的作用。

payload.subject: biology
payload.title: 光合作用与呼吸作用

payload.subject: history
payload.title: 工业革命
payload.description: 工业革命首先从18世纪60年代的英国兴起，以机器生产逐步代替手工劳动。它提高了生产力，促进工厂制度和城市化，也加剧了环境污染和社会矛盾。

payload.subject: history

payload.subject: history
